description:
PRE-LAUNCH DBC economics readout: decodes the exact Meteora DBC config the gateway will sign (scaled per quote decimals) and simulates the dev-buy with the official SDK swap math. Returns migration threshold, start price, curve breakdown, tokens out (supply-capped) and min-out after slippage. Call this instead of estimating locally — the frontend renders these values verbatim.

SAP MCP execution guidance: Intent: SAP MCP tool workflow. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required.

quotePriceUsd.description: Live USD price of one quote token; required for non-SOL quotes.

solPriceUsd.description: Live SOL/USD reference; required for non-SOL quotes.
